tasks.title: Get approval for the December visit
tasks.explanation: Confirm with probation that Linus is permitted to travel to Sweden in December.

tasks.title: Confirm permitted travel dates and reporting conditions
tasks.explanation: Once approval is given, note exact dates, any check-in requirements, and any restrictions.

tasks.title: Book the December journey
tasks.explanation: Flight or ferry + onward travel to the Swedish address.

tasks.title: Confirm Linus's licence end date
tasks.explanation: Written confirmation of when licence conditions end.

tasks.title: Confirm the permanent move date (Feb 2027)
tasks.explanation: Fix a target date so everything else can plan against it.

tasks.title: Plan the final journey from England to Sweden
tasks.explanation: Route, transport, luggage, timing.

tasks.title: Check current Skatteverket requirements
tasks.explanation: Rules for a Swedish citizen moving back to Sweden. Requirements change; verify close to the visit.

tasks.title: Confirm which documents to bring
tasks.explanation: Passport, proof of address, any other evidence Skatteverket asks for.

tasks.title: Gather Swedish passport and personal identity number
tasks.explanation: Locate the passport, note SPIN, store securely in Vault.

tasks.title: Gather proof of intended Swedish address
tasks.explanation: Letter or written statement from the person Linus will live with.

tasks.title: Locate the appropriate Swedish state service centre
tasks.explanation: Find the nearest Statens servicecenter that handles folkbokföring.

tasks.title: Check whether an appointment is required
tasks.explanation: Some service centres are drop-in, others require booking.

tasks.title: Attend the service centre in person
tasks.explanation: Linus must appear in person for the identity check.

tasks.title: Complete the identity check
tasks.explanation: In-person ID verification at the service centre.

tasks.title: Submit the notification of moving to Sweden
tasks.explanation: Flyttanmälan filed at the service centre.

tasks.title: Record the case or reference number
tasks.explanation: Store in the Vault so we can chase it up.

tasks.title: Upload copies of the submitted documents
tasks.explanation: Photograph everything that was handed in.

tasks.title: Track the application's progress
tasks.explanation: Weekly check on the case status.

tasks.title: Respond to any Skatteverket requests
tasks.explanation: If they ask for more information, act quickly.

tasks.title: Record the official population-registration decision
tasks.explanation: The date Skatteverket registers Linus. This unlocks many later steps.

tasks.title: Compare suitable Swedish bank accounts
tasks.explanation: Shortlist 2-3 banks based on ID requirements and fees.

tasks.title: Check each bank's identification requirements
tasks.explanation: Some accept passport only, others need folkbokföring.

tasks.title: Collect the documents required by the chosen bank
tasks.explanation: ID, address proof, any employment info if needed.

tasks.title: Book a bank appointment if necessary
tasks.explanation: Some accounts need in-person opening.

tasks.title: Open or reactivate a Swedish bank account
tasks.explanation: May require folkbokföring first.

tasks.title: Apply for BankID
tasks.explanation: Unlocks nearly every Swedish online service. Needs a bank account first.

tasks.title: Test access to important Swedish online services
tasks.explanation: 1177, Skatteverket, Försäkringskassan, Arbetsförmedlingen.

tasks.title: Consider obtaining a Swedish national ID card
tasks.explanation: Useful as a portable ID; requires folkbokföring.

tasks.title: Set up a Swedish mobile number
tasks.explanation: Prepaid SIM is fine initially.

tasks.title: Set up a digital mailbox (Kivra)
tasks.explanation: Receives official post digitally. Needs BankID.

tasks.title: Create a Swedish CV
tasks.explanation: Swedish CV conventions differ from UK; include personnummer once available.

tasks.title: Prepare a general cover-letter template
tasks.explanation: One base template Linus can tailor per application.

tasks.title: Collect employment references and certificates
tasks.explanation: Scans of everything from UK employers.

tasks.title: Translate important qualifications
tasks.explanation: Certified translations for anything Linus wants recognised in Sweden.

tasks.title: Identify suitable types of work
tasks.explanation: Shortlist realistic roles based on skills and post-release circumstances.

tasks.title: Create a list of potential employers
tasks.explanation: Local companies, staffing agencies, sectors that hire quickly.

tasks.title: Begin searching for jobs
tasks.explanation: Platsbanken, Blocket Jobb, LinkedIn. Log everything in the app.

tasks.title: Register with Arbetsförmedlingen if appropriate
tasks.explanation: Free job-support service; some programmes require folkbokföring.

tasks.title: Track job applications and interviews
tasks.explanation: Ongoing log of every application, response, and interview.

tasks.title: Record employer contacts and follow-up dates
tasks.explanation: Names, phone numbers, dates promised for follow-up.

tasks.title: Assess Linus's current Swedish level
tasks.explanation: Self-assessment plus a rough CEFR estimate.

tasks.title: Research suitable SFI or Komvux courses
tasks.explanation: Free Swedish tuition; availability depends on kommun.

tasks.title: Check the local application requirements
tasks.explanation: Every kommun has slightly different rules.

tasks.title: Gather previous education records
tasks.explanation: Certificates, transcripts, anything Komvux might ask for.

tasks.title: Apply for SFI when eligible
tasks.explanation: Most kommuns require folkbokföring at that address.

tasks.title: Record course dates and attendance information
tasks.explanation: In the Vault so we can plan around it.

tasks.title: Create longer-term language goals
tasks.explanation: 12-month plan; e.g. reach B1 within a year.

tasks.title: Research progression beyond SFI (SAS)
tasks.explanation: Swedish as a Second Language, university access.

tasks.title: Confirm where Linus will initially live
tasks.explanation: Address, contact person, arrival arrangements.

tasks.title: Record full Swedish address and contact person
tasks.explanation: Store in the Vault. Needed for folkbokföring and everything else.

tasks.title: Prepare a basic accommodation budget
tasks.explanation: Rent contribution, utilities, food.

tasks.title: Search for longer-term accommodation
tasks.explanation: Rental options, sublet options, second-hand market.

tasks.title: Register with relevant housing queues
tasks.explanation: Bostadsförmedlingen and other kommun queues; queue time is currency.

tasks.title: Track housing applications
tasks.explanation: Ongoing log of what's been applied for.

tasks.title: Store landlord or housing-company contacts
tasks.explanation: In Vault contacts.

tasks.title: Arrange home insurance when required
tasks.explanation: Hemförsäkring is essentially mandatory in Sweden.

tasks.title: Check eligibility with Försäkringskassan
tasks.explanation: Registration is separate from folkbokföring but often linked.

tasks.title: Determine whether financial-support applications are appropriate
tasks.explanation: Do NOT assume entitlement; check case by case.

tasks.title: Register with the relevant healthcare services
tasks.explanation: Region-specific; folkbokföring usually needed.

tasks.title: Choose or register with a local health centre (vårdcentral)
tasks.explanation: Named GP-equivalent; can list preferences.

tasks.title: Set up access to 1177
tasks.explanation: Healthcare online portal; needs BankID.

tasks.title: Identify local social-care or practical support if needed
tasks.explanation: Kommun-run support services.

tasks.title: Record important municipal contact details
tasks.explanation: Kommun switchboard, housing, socialtjänst.

tasks.title: Create an emergency contact list
tasks.explanation: Family, closest friend, medical contact, kommun.

tasks.title: Confirm all probation or licence requirements have ended
tasks.explanation: Written confirmation before departure.

tasks.title: Give required notice for current UK accommodation
tasks.explanation: Whatever notice period applies.

tasks.title: Notify relevant UK organisations of the move
tasks.explanation: HMRC, DWP, NHS, DVLA, bank, insurers.

tasks.title: Arrange transfer of medical records and prescriptions
tasks.explanation: Where transferable; keep copies regardless.

tasks.title: Review UK banking and recurring payments
tasks.explanation: Cancel what's ending, keep what's still needed.

tasks.title: Cancel or transfer utilities, subscriptions, phone
tasks.explanation: One list; work through it.

tasks.title: Redirect important post
tasks.explanation: Royal Mail redirection to Oscar or another trusted UK address.

tasks.title: Decide what to sell, store, or take to Sweden
tasks.explanation: One decision per category of stuff.

tasks.title: Arrange transport for belongings
tasks.explanation: Courier, freight, or extra luggage.

tasks.title: Keep copies of important UK records
tasks.explanation: Scan everything worth scanning; store in Vault.

tasks.title: Confirm access to the Swedish address
tasks.explanation: Someone is there when Linus arrives.

tasks.title: Obtain keys
tasks.explanation: Handed over on arrival.

tasks.title: Complete an initial food and household shop
tasks.explanation: First 3 days of food and basics.

tasks.title: Confirm phone and internet access
tasks.explanation: Working SIM, working home wifi.

tasks.title: Learn the local public transport
tasks.explanation: SL / Skånetrafiken / Västtrafik card, main routes.

tasks.title: Confirm banking and BankID access
tasks.explanation: Everything logs in as expected.

tasks.title: Attend any scheduled appointments
tasks.explanation: Whatever is on the calendar for the first weeks.

tasks.title: Review outstanding applications
tasks.explanation: Weekly triage of anything still open.

tasks.title: Create a first-month budget
tasks.explanation: What comes in, what goes out.

tasks.title: Arrange a weekly check-in with Oscar
tasks.explanation: Fixed day and time; short and honest.

tasks.title: List family and trusted contacts in Sweden
tasks.explanation: Everyone who could realistically be called on.

tasks.title: Record who can help with different matters
tasks.explanation: One person per topic (housing, health, work, admin).

tasks.title: Arrange regular check-ins between Linus and Oscar
tasks.explanation: Before the move too, not just after.

tasks.title: Shared list of questions to ask officials
tasks.explanation: Living document; add as things come up.
